scope: All active editorial lines in canonical registry, cross-checked with current public corpus and selected dated primary releases. This is a nonpublic screening record, not a claim of exhaustive global negative evidence.

reviewed_lines.note: MT-GM-2026-10-26 approved and present in reports; election result and pre-opening cross-asset analysis not duplicated.
26 Oct weekly wealth flow public in HEAD; separate weekly producer owns revisions.
WHO 23 Oct DRC cross-border case delta belongs in pandemic response assessment, not a new country transition dossier.
DRC security and health institutions assessed in thematic article; no new standalone country-context source package.
WHO 23 Oct TUMAINI trial start is clinical enrollment, not demonstrated vaccine efficacy or scalable production.
UNICEF/Gavi manufacturer expression of interest is prospective supply preparation, not approved or deployed vaccine capacity.
DRC insecurity and displacement affect health-team access; no unverified claim of intentional biological attack.
World Bank and WHO response capacity assessed; no distinct control/ownership change demonstrated.
26 Oct Global Macro public; no additional monetary decision with distinct verified causal delta at early cutoff.
WHO emergency coordination and trial enrollment verified; institutional effects covered in Ebola study.
World Bank reported improved Ebola detection time; not an independently identified causal evaluation of policy.
No new implemented market-design rule with sufficient verified delta in screened releases.
World Bank US$426.6m is current and planned financing, not a global change in beneficial asset ownership.
No new audited stock of sovereign assets or control inventory identified.
WHO/Africa CDC and World Bank coordination is material but integrated into health assessment; no new institutional architecture demonstrated.
Cross-border Ebola surveillance in DRC/Kenya/Nigeria is operational cooperation, not implemented trade-bloc or payments integration.
Health technology, access and social trust examined in Ebola assessment; no independent deployment study justified.
Food availability and agricultural transport can be affected by DRC access restrictions; no new quantified production or nutrition delta verified.
Pesticide exposure, livestock handling and AMR baselines reviewed; no new verified regulatory implementation or measured exposure. Bundibugyo is not alleged to be weaponized.
Conflict is a verified constraint on DRC health access, not evidence of imminent interstate war or chemical/biological attack.
WHO DON622 confirms new Nigerian imported case, Kenya linked cluster and tracing deficit; World Bank and UNICEF document finance and social effects. New EN/PT assessment staged.
No new primary historical archive or materially corrective source identified in this daily event-driven screen.
Existing energy-security and grid research covers baseline; no fresh operational capacity change established in current screening.
Brazilian runoff result and high dollar financing costs already treated in public 26 Oct Global Macro; avoid duplicate.
Brazil rare earths and resource-sovereignty research published 25 Oct; no verified new resource control or mining permit delta.
Itaipu, Paraguay and data-centre energy-security research already public 25 Oct; no new implemented grid or treaty change verified.

selection_reason: WHO 23 Oct DON622 reports imported Nigerian case after Kenyan linked cluster; 9,704 DRC cases, contact tracing deficit, TUMAINI trial start, and verified UNICEF/World Bank operational evidence form a substantive cross-border health-system and socioeconomic delta distinct from 19 Oct COVID preparedness retrospective.

screened_primary_sources.use: DRC/Kenya/Nigeria cases, tracing, clinical trial, trade advice
digital infrastructure strategy is an announcement, not deployment
prior-vintage AMR baseline, not a new 26 Oct signal

limitations: Case counts primarily as of 20 October; no independent 26 October epidemiological totals included.
No current primary evidence of Ebola-related generalized trade closures, biological weaponization or macroeconomic loss magnitude.
Food, pesticide, livestock, chemical-weapons and broad technology lines were screened selectively; absence of a staged article is not proof that no event occurred anywhere.
